notes.title: Fixes + Multiplayer improvements - V1.18
notes.notes:
[p]Here are some more corrections:[/p][p] Multiplayer: If the player loses all their lives, they can play again, consuming one of the other player's lives (Bug that prevented the player from moving when resurrecting, was fixed).[/p][list][*][p]Possible divergence between the demo save and the full game;[/p][/*][*][p]Possible softlocks when falling on platform sections;[/p][/*][*][p]Large accumulation of enemies in a single point of the map could cause collision problems between them and the scenery;[/p][/*][*][p]Defense and parry mechanics have been balanced;[/p][/*][*][p]Improved audio mixing; [/p][/*][*][p]Some actions combined with dodging could make the player reach places they shouldn't[/p][/*][*][p]All achievements are unlocked as they should[/p][/*][*][p]Collecting all ARCADES COLLECTIBLES unlocks the CRT FILTERS in options menu.[/p][/*][/list][p]Among other small fixes, to improve the player experience.

Thank you all and keep beat 'em up!![/p]

notes.title: Correction of Collectibles, achievements, and more... V1.12
notes.notes:
[p]We fixed a bug that could show an incorrect number of Arcades collected in Level Select. Some Arcades had duplicate IDs, which prevented them from appearing correctly in some stages.

If you still have problems with this, we suggest you delete the save file for last year's old demo, which may be conflicting with the full game. Just go to the folder “C:\\Users\\User\\AppData\\Local\\REALITY_RASH\\Saved\\SaveGames” and delete the file “progress.sav” (exactly like that, without any numbers). 

[b]Your progress will not be affected![/b] 

There was an enemy in level 3-3 that in rare cases would prevent a door from opening after clearing the area. 

Achievements related to completing the game might not unlock correctly.

The Cores that could get stuck outside the map after defeating a boss have been fixed. 

Among other minor fixes to improve the player experience.

Thank you!![/p]

notes.title: UPDATE 1.10
notes.notes:
[p]We received reports about the elevator stopping in Stage 4-4, so we spoke to the building manager and:

[/p][list][*][p] Fixed potential collision bugs with the elevator walls;
[/p][/*][*][p] Prevented an error that could stop enemies from entering the elevator properly;
  [/p][/*][*][p] Added a 60-second timer to make the elevator go up to the next floor even if enemies from the previous floor are still alive — this prevents players from getting stuck there.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]Blocking and Parrying[/b] now have a wider angle! You’ll be able to defend against attacks coming from the front and sides — but not from behind. This is a street fight, so always watch your back!

[b]Grabbing enemies[/b] now has greater range. Try tossing them around now!

[b]Enemy voices[/b] have been added — now every enemy has something to say!

Fixed some [b]achievements[/b] that weren’t unlocking correctly.

Fixed a bug that blocked progress if an enemy was killed with a finisher after a successful parry.

With this update, we’ve fixed all major bugs in Reality Rash!

The game has improved a lot in this launch week, and I’m incredibly grateful for all your feedback.

More updates coming soon!!

[/p]

notes.title: Fred and Jessy more dynamic + fixes - 1.0.2
Day one update 1.0.1
notes.notes:
[p]As promised, the launch patch!!!
[/p][p]We fixed several bugs, most of them possible softlocks that may or may not occur during the game:[/p][p]
Bug that prevented progress on Map 2-5;[/p][p]Bug that made parkour difficult on Map 2-4;[/p][p]Dodge now has a 0.25 second cooldown before being able to roll again;[/p][p]Improved respawn system for when the player falls down a hole (all stages);[/p][p]Improved Elevator on stage 4-4;[/p][p]Improved boss fights. These are just a few examples, among many other improvements.[/p][p]
Use the community to report bugs, the most serious ones can be fixed the same day![/p][p]
Thank you for your patience and trust![/p]
